reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper and adds a shared isNonWorkingDay predicate that every weekend site now uses, instead of adding holiday checks per site.

duplication.why: No new copied logic; the holiday rule is defined once, though the diff threads the holidays argument through four pre-existing parallel skip/move sites rather than consolidating them.

placement.why: The day rule and movement live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helpers; the type change is in RecurConfig and parseRecurDate carries the field.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its type, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single predicate makes the rule easy to change; the per-site daily-skip-vs-move dispatch and the holidayCount window heuristics remain scattered.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend checks (shared/schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts, schedule-template.ts) now go through isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts define the holiday-as-weekend rule; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all call them.
